name: Dottid
positioning: A leasing workflow platform replacing the spreadsheets and email chains commercial asset teams use to track deals.
description: Dottid is a commercial real estate leasing and asset management platform, owned by JLL, used to track deal pipelines, capital projects and portfolio performance across office, industrial and retail assets. It integrates with ARGUS MLA and offers stacking plan visualization, team task management and a mobile app.
real_estate_use: An asset management team replaces spreadsheets and email threads with Dottid to track every lease from prospect to signature, see a stacking plan of who occupies what floor, and pull real-time portfolio performance figures for an investor update, all synced with ARGUS MLA rather than re-keyed.
features: Deal pipeline and leasing workflow tracking
Mobile app for stacking plans and files

use_cases.job: Track a lease from prospect to signature and report portfolio performance without spreadsheets
See a stacking plan of occupancy across a commercial portfolio
